goal: A REST shopping-cart service: add items, update quantities, remove items and check out with a persisted order.

requirements.title: Add item to cart
requirements.body: A shopper can add a product to their cart with a positive quantity; adding an existing product increases its quantity.
acceptance: Given an empty cart when adding product P1 qty 2 then the cart contains P1 with quantity 2
Given a cart with P1 qty 2 when adding P1 qty 1 then the cart contains P1 with quantity 3

requirements.title: Update item quantity
requirements.body: A shopper can set a cart item's quantity to any value >= 1; setting 0 removes the item.
acceptance: Given a cart with P1 qty 2 when setting qty 5 then the cart shows P1 qty 5
Given a cart with P1 qty 2 when setting qty 0 then the cart no longer contains P1

requirements.title: Cart total
requirements.body: The cart exposes a total: the sum of unit price times quantity over all items, before tax.
acceptance: Given P1 (10.00) qty 2 and P2 (5.50) qty 1 when requesting the total then the total is 25.50

requirements.title: Checkout creates an order
requirements.body: Checkout converts the cart into a persisted order with a unique id, the items, the total and a timestamp, then empties the cart.
acceptance: Given a cart with items when checking out then an order exists with those items and the cart is empty

requirements.title: Unknown product rejected
requirements.body: Adding a product id that is not in the catalogue fails with a 404 and does not change the cart.
acceptance: Given product PX not in catalogue when adding PX then the API returns 404 and the cart is unchanged

requirements.title: Cart response time
requirements.body: Cart read and write operations respond within 200 ms at 50 concurrent shoppers.
acceptance: Given 50 concurrent shoppers when measuring cart operations then p95 latency is under 200 ms

assumptions.text: Prices come from the product catalogue; the cart never stores prices.
One cart per shopper session, identified by a cart token header.

glossary.definition: Opaque header value identifying one cart.
